test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"threats."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **
 

__
 
• The word **"threats"** means a warning that somebody may hurt, kill or punish you if you do not do what he/she wants. ((इच्छित काम न करने पर) (चोट पहुँचाने या मार देने की) धमकी)

 
 
• **Example**: *She was fired after making **threats**__ to her co-workers.*
 
 
 
• The sentence conveys that light is one of the biggest dangers to textiles.
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct paragraph: 

One of the greatest __**threats**__ to textiles is light. It is a form of energy that can fade colour and cause chemical and physical ______ (2) ______ of textile fibres. Exposure to both, natural and ultra violet light can threaten the ______ (3) ______ of textiles. Light damage occurs progressively. You must have noticed at home that the most faded folds of curtains are the first to ______ (4) ______ and fall apart. Fading of colours and alterations of hues are the ______ (5) ______ easy-to-detect signs of light damage. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Beauties: **the quality which gives pleasure to the senses; the state of being beautiful. (इंद्रियों को सुखद लगनेवाले लक्ष्ण; सुंदरता, ख़ूबसूरती, आकर्षण; सौंदर्य)
 
• **Additions: **the action or process of adding something to something else. (किसी चीज़ में कुछ जोड़ने की क्रिया या प्रक्रिया)
 
• **Warnings: **something that tells you to be careful or tells you about something, usually something bad, before it happens. ((प्रायः अशुभ स्थिति से) सतर्क करने वाली बात; पूर्वसूचना, चेतावनी)
